title: Infused Crystal Anvil
text: Upgrade a crystal anvil using the same advanced assembly layout. It has unlimited durability and still allows immediate forging by paying experience.

Either end of the through-shaft can drive automatic forging, replacing each experience level with 20 seconds. Requires at least 16 rpm with a fixed 256 SU load, or 256 FE/second. More power does not speed it up. Power loss pauses progress; changed inputs or names restart it. Electric drive leaves the shaft still.
